description: Give AI coding agents shared long-term memory and live work context across tools, sessions, machines, and team members. Vibsync preserves discoveries, product knowledge, decisions, questions, tasks, and active work areas so the team does not repeat the same research or overwrite each other’s work. Git remains the source of truth; Vibsync is a collaboration context layer, not an agent orchestrator.

defaultPrompt: Onboard me to my team's current AI development context.
Recall what the team already knows about this codebase.
Check for overlapping work before I edit these files.
